content: Certain diagnostic procedures, such as X-rays of the intestines that involve the use of contrast dye, may potentially interfere with the accuracy of test results. Overdose Instructions: If an individual has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call emergency services (911 in the United States). If the symptoms are not life-threatening, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222, while Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Hydration Advice for Diarrhea Treatment: If you are using this medication to manage diarrhea, it is essential to consume an adequate amount of water to minimize the risk of dehydration. Missed Dose Instructions: If you forget to take a dose, administer it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to compensate for the missed one. Storage Guidelines: Store this medication at room temperature, ensuring it is kept away from direct light and moisture. Do not freeze the medication. Avoid storing it in the bathroom, as the humidity may compromise its stability. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. When the product has expired or is no longer needed, dispose of it properly in accordance with local waste disposal regulations. Important Information About This Document: This document provides a summary of information and does not include all possible details about this product. This information is not intended to replace personalized medical advice from your healthcare provider. Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this product and to address your individual health needs.
